messages.author: fd248aedd6f929a2
messages.subject: error message from lavaan.survey
parts:
I am trying to use lavaan.survey for data that are "cluster sampled", i.e., nested (multiple samples within sites). In Mplus, I would use the "cluster = sitenum" statement.
 
When executing the following two lines for a lavaan object,
 
survey.design <- svydesign(ids=~sitenum, nest=TRUE, data=plot.sem.dat0)        #specify the survey design
survey.fit <- lavaan.survey(lavaan.fit=mod.plot.0, survey.design=survey.design)   #adjust for survey design
I get the error message
 
"Error in lavaan.survey(lavaan.fit = mod.plot.0, survey.design = survey.design) :
  trying to get slot "Data" from an object of a basic class ("character") with no slots"
Does anyone know how to interpret this message?
 
Jim Grace

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: error message from lavaan.survey
parts:
> When executing the following two lines for a lavaan object,
> survey.design <- svydesign(ids=~sitenum, nest=TRUE,
> data=plot.sem.dat0) #specify the survey design
> survey.fit <- lavaan.survey(lavaan.fit=mod.plot.0,
> survey.design=survey.design) #adjust for survey design
> I get the error message
> "Error in lavaan.survey(lavaan.fit = mod.plot.0, survey.design =
> survey.design) :
> trying to get slot "Data" from an object of a basic class
> ("character") with no slots"
> Does anyone know how to interpret this message?

Is mod.plot.0 a fitted lavaan object? Try

class(mod.plot.0)

it should say

[1] "lavaan"
attr(,"package")
[1] "lavaan

The error message says that it tries to extract a slot 'Data' from the
S4 class 'lavaan', but instead of a lavaan object, it found an object of
type character.

If mod.plot.0 is of class lavaan, I'm not sure what went wrong. In that
case, could you send me your full script and perhaps a snippet of the
data (just enough to reproduce the error)?

Yves.
